runs.stdout:
eldap_alone: {error,{not_started,asn1}}
mimapp_alone: {error,{not_started,sasl}}
ensure_all_started: {ok,[sasl,inets,tools,runtime_tools,asn1,eldap,xmerl,
                         compiler,syntax_tools,mimapp]}
which_applications: [{mimapp,"Depends on the applications MongooseIM lists",
                             "1.0.0"},
                     {syntax_tools,"Syntax tools","4.1.1"},
                     {compiler,"ERTS  CXC 138 10","10.0.6"},
                     {xmerl,"XML parser","2.2"},
                     {eldap,"Ldap api","1.3.1"},
                     {asn1,"The Erlang ASN1 compiler version 5.5.2","5.5.2"},
                     {runtime_tools,"RUNTIME_TOOLS","2.5"},
                     {tools,"DEVTOOLS  CXC 138 16","4.2.3"},
                     {inets,"INETS  CXC 138 49","9.8"},
                     {sasl,"SASL  CXC 138 11","4.4"},
                     {stdlib,"ERTS  CXC 138 10","8.1"},
                     {kernel,"ERTS  CXC 138 10","11.0.4"}]
sasl: [{description,{ok,"SASL  CXC 138 11"}},
       {vsn,{ok,"4.4"}},
       {registered,{ok,[sasl_sup,alarm_handler,release_handler]}},
       {applications,{ok,[kernel,stdlib]}},
       {env,{ok,[]}}]
inets: [{description,{ok,"INETS  CXC 138 49"}},
        {vsn,{ok,"9.8"}},
        {registered,{ok,[inets_sup,httpc_manager]}},
        {applications,{ok,[kernel,stdlib]}},
        {env,{ok,[]}}]
tools: [{description,{ok,"DEVTOOLS  CXC 138 16"}},
        {vsn,{ok,"4.2.3"}},
        {registered,{ok,[]}},
        {applications,{ok,[kernel,stdlib]}},
        {env,
            {ok,[{file_util_search_methods,
                     [{[],[]},{"ebin","esrc"},{"ebin","src"}]}]}}]
runtime_tools: [{description,{ok,"RUNTIME_TOOLS"}},
                {vsn,{ok,"2.5"}},
                {registered,{ok,[runtime_tools_sup]}},
                {applications,{ok,[kernel,stdlib]}},
                {env,{ok,[{ttb_autostart_module,ttb_autostart}]}}]
asn1: [{description,{ok,"The Erlang ASN1 compiler version 5.5.2"}},
       {vsn,{ok,"5.5.2"}},
       {registered,{ok,[asn1_ns,asn1db]}},
       {applications,{ok,[kernel,stdlib]}},
       {env,{ok,[]}}]
eldap: [{description,{ok,"Ldap api"}},
        {vsn,{ok,"1.3.1"}},
        {registered,{ok,[]}},
        {applications,{ok,[kernel,stdlib,asn1]}},
        {env,{ok,[]}}]
xmerl: [{description,{ok,"XML parser"}},
        {vsn,{ok,"2.2"}},
        {registered,{ok,[]}},
        {applications,{ok,[kernel,stdlib]}},
        {env,{ok,[]}}]
compiler: [{description,{ok,"ERTS  CXC 138 10"}},
           {vsn,{ok,"10.0.6"}},
           {registered,{ok,[]}},
           {applications,{ok,[kernel,stdlib]}},
           {env,{ok,[]}}]
syntax_tools: [{description,{ok,"Syntax tools"}},
               {vsn,{ok,"4.1.1"}},
               {registered,{ok,[]}},
               {applications,{ok,[stdlib]}},
               {env,{ok,[]}}]
registered: [sasl_sup,sasl_safe_sup,alarm_handler,release_handler,inets_sup,
             httpc_sup,httpc_profile_sup,httpc_manager,httpc_handler_sup,
             httpd_sup,runtime_tools_sup]
sasl_sup: {release_handler,worker,[],release_handler,
                           [{id,release_handler},
                            {modules,[]},
                            {restart,permanent},
                            {shutdown,2000},
                            {significant,false},
                            {type,worker}]}
sasl_sup: {sasl_safe_sup,supervisor,
                         [sasl],
                         sasl_safe_sup,
                         [{id,sasl_safe_sup},
                          {modules,[sasl]},
                          {restart,permanent},
                          {shutdown,infinity},
                          {significant,false},
                          {type,supervisor}]}
sasl_safe_sup: {alarm_handler,worker,dynamic,alarm_handler,
                              [{id,alarm_handler},
                               {modules,dynamic},
                               {restart,permanent},
                               {shutdown,2000},
                               {significant,false},
                               {type,worker}]}
inets_sup: {httpd_sup,supervisor,
                      [httpd_sup],
                      httpd_sup,
                      [{id,httpd_sup},
                       {modules,[httpd_sup]},
                       {restart,permanent},
                       {shutdown,infinity},
                       {significant,false},
                       {type,supervisor}]}
inets_sup: {httpc_sup,supervisor,
                      [httpc_sup],
                      httpc_sup,
                      [{id,httpc_sup},
                       {modules,[httpc_sup]},
                       {restart,permanent},
                       {shutdown,infinity},
                       {significant,false},
                       {type,supervisor}]}
httpc_sup: {httpc_handler_sup,supervisor,
                              [httpc_handler_sup],
                              httpc_handler_sup,
                              [{id,httpc_handler_sup},
                               {modules,[httpc_handler_sup]},
                               {restart,permanent},
                               {shutdown,infinity},
                               {significant,false},
                               {type,supervisor}]}
httpc_sup: {httpc_profile_sup,supervisor,
                              [httpc_profile_sup],
                              httpc_profile_sup,
                              [{id,httpc_profile_sup},
                               {modules,[httpc_profile_sup]},
                               {restart,permanent},
                               {shutdown,infinity},
                               {significant,false},
                               {type,supervisor}]}
httpc_profile_sup: {httpc_manager,worker,
                                  [httpc_manager],
                                  httpc_manager,
                                  [{id,httpc_manager},
                                   {modules,[httpc_manager]},
                                   {restart,permanent},
                                   {shutdown,4000},
                                   {significant,false},
                                   {type,worker}]}
runtime_tools_sup: {ttb_autostart,worker,
                                  [ttb_autostart],
                                  unregistered,
                                  [{id,ttb_autostart},
                                   {modules,[ttb_autostart]},
                                   {restart,temporary},
                                   {shutdown,3000},
                                   {significant,false},
                                   {type,worker}]}
set: [ok,ok,ok,ok]
get: [{{c,1},"text"},{b,x},{a,2},{a,1}]
clear: [ok,ok]
set_any: ok
get: [notatuple,{{c,1},"text"},{b,x},{a,1}]
unknown_call: {error,bad_query}
handler_init: []
handler_init: args
add: [ok,ok]
handlers: [mim_applications,mim_applications,alarm_handler]
set: ok
handler_event: {{set_alarm,{d,1}},args}
handler_event: {{set_alarm,{d,1}},[]}
get: [{d,1},notatuple,{{c,1},"text"},{b,x},{a,1}]
handler_terminate: {[],args}
handler_terminate: {[],[]}
delete: [{terminated,args},{terminated,[]}]
delete_default: ok
get_without: {error,bad_module}
add_default: [ok,ok]
get: [{e,1}]
handler_init: {swapped,{alarm_handler,[{e,1}]}}
swap: ok
handlers: [mim_applications]
swap_back: ok
get: []
stopped: [ok,ok,ok,ok,ok,ok,ok,ok,ok,ok]
registered_after: []
alarms_after: {exit,
                  {noproc,
                      {gen_event,call,
                          [alarm_handler,alarm_handler,get_alarms]}}}
mim_applications: ok
